ownerDecision.instruction: Close Gekta issue #4332 without weakening production acceptance; preserve keyboard ownership across transient focus loss and preserve controlled composer drafts under real Safari/WebKit input events. Production run 32126929169 exposed an additional Chromium resize-cycle focus gap after the viewport had expanded, so retain only a bounded text-entry engagement grace while clearing keyboard-open state immediately below the inset threshold.

constraints: Do not weaken viewport, overlap, draft, caret, localization, touch-target or exact-revision gates.

A contracted visual viewport may retain keyboard eligibility after transient focus loss only after a text-entry control was engaged; data-gekta-keyboard-open must clear immediately after the viewport expands below the keyboard threshold.

Bound stale text-entry eligibility with a short grace period and clear it immediately on an explicit non-text pointer or focus target so arbitrary later viewport contraction cannot masquerade as a keyboard.
Composer edits must update the controlled draft from native input events in Chromium and WebKit without test-only fallbacks.
No backend, auth, model, database, registration, role or business-logic changes.
